title: Award Price Protection: The Rebooking Protection Window for Returned Free Night Awards
content:
**Clause.** When one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay is applied to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation, rebooking protection reads the award's latest return record:

- when that return is dated within the protection window, fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the hold, and came from a stay at the same hotel as the new reservation, the night is priced at the lower of its price and the protected rebooking price on that return;
- when it is dated within the window and came from a stay at another hotel, the night is priced at the lower of its price and the protected rebooking price plus one season step of the new reservation's category;
- otherwise the night is priced at its own price.

The night's price here is the price of the new night on the Ashbury Rewards award chart for the category and season of the new reservation.

## Reading the records

| Element | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The latest return record | The most recent release record (return entry) in the award's history, by its date |
| The protection window | 3 whole calendar months, counted from the date of that return to the date of the hold; the return is within the window when fewer than 3 whole months have passed |
| The protected rebooking price on that return | The points price stated on that return record |
| Same hotel or another hotel | The hotel of the reservation named on that return record, compared with the hotel of the new reservation, both as their Room Reservations records show them |
| One season step of the new reservation's category | The step for the category recorded on the new reservation |

| Award categories | Season step (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 to 3 | 2500 |
| 4 to 6 | 5000 |
| 7 | 10000 |
| 8 | 15000 |

## Truth table

| Latest return within the window | Return came from a stay at the same hotel | Night priced at |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The lower of the night's price and the protected rebooking price |
| Yes | No | The lower of the night's price and the protected rebooking price plus one season step |
| No | Yes or no | The night's own price |

## Cases (hypothetical new night in category 4 priced at 30000 points, hold dated 15 August)

| Latest return | Protected rebooking price on it | Priced at |
|---|---|---|
| Dated 16 May, same hotel (two whole months) | 26000 | 26000 |
| Dated 16 May, another hotel | 26000 | 30000, the lower of 30000 and 31000 |
| Dated 16 May, another hotel | 22000 | 27000, the lower of 30000 and 27000 |
| Dated 15 May, same hotel (three whole months) | 26000 | 30000, outside the window |
